description: No charge. Rebuild an owned unsent draft using id, exact version and the latest enabled saved version of its associated rule. Retains edited letter text, applies updated addresses, font, color, formatting, page cap and latest active letterhead version (archived presets retain the pinned version), recalculates price and increments version. Always forces approval mode and strips autosend consent; never buys postage, changes credits or dispatches. Production key required. Refuses submitted, uncertain, rejected, deletion-pending and one-time drafts without a saved rule. Optional ruleFingerprint guards an already-reviewed rule snapshot with its resolved latest letterhead reference; concurrent rule/letterhead/draft changes reject the update. Download and review the regenerated PDF and address before explicitly approving.
name: reapply_email_letter
title: Reapply Email Letter
